The target remains reachable, while the water makes line and distance matter. The par-3/5/4 sequence and contrast between a water-influenced target, a bending three-shot hole and a dry long par 4 give the round strong internal variety. Recent rounds include long par 3s and long par 5s, but this combination, water placement and sequence are sufficiently distinct. Dispersion probes show playable tee outcomes on all three holes, with recoverable misses; the first hole’s water carry and the par 5’s length and bends provide a challenging but fair round.
